title: kithctl watch: Message/changes with maxChanges=50 silently drops messages when hasMoreChanges=true
description: fetch_and_notify (watch.rs line 414) calls Message/changes with maxChanges=50. If more than 50 messages arrive in a single state window (burst or backlog), hasMoreChanges=true and the remaining messages are silently ignored — no pagination loop. The SSE event loop does not re-enter fetch_and_notify for the remainder, so those messages produce no desktop notification. On reconnect the state baseline is updated and the missed messages are lost forever.
